title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah, my dear trainer! The vaunted day is upon us!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby, which some refer to as the Tokyo Yushun…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Has sold out! It will be a live orchestra, and the lineup is replete with this year's brightest stars!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: However, their only purpose is to make me shine all the more brighter!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hark, this young Overlord's reign shall last forever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just coming to the Derby has already gotten her amped up. We head for the paddock side by side.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oh, Ayabe. I see you've positioned yourself on the board well to make it here.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: What say you? For this momentous occasion, will you not join me in a song before the race?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …No. I'm not going along with your shtick. But…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I won't pin the blame on you anymore either.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Blame? Whatever do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: The Satsuki Sho, I… I couldn't bear responsibility for myself.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: So I played the victim. That's why I couldn't finish strong.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: But today… I'm focusing inward.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm here… because I want to run. I'll win this Derby through my own will.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Interesting… So that is your mindset.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You are indeed the Umamusume I thought you were. I'm sure you agree, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: More deflection and laughter… I don't think she understands Admire Vega's feelings all that well.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: In any case, I'm glad to see the fire in your eyes! You are a worthy rival, Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Show me what you can do! Are you simply a supporting role or…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Are you the comrade who joins me in the battle against the older generation?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The plot for today's act is yet to be written! Its fate lies within our strides.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, to victory!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ayabe's changed. She hated talking to Opera O when they first met, but now…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: She stood up for herself—with determination too. Wow… It's going to be a good race.
